correctness.rationale: Every ordered deletion of P corresponds to a unique weakly increasing tuple of source-period indices. Its cumulative phase counts form a bijective weakly increasing q+1-valued sequence, whose rotations concatenate to the remainder. Only 0 and q share a rotation, yielding one r+1-sized fiber and otherwise unique output. The binomial-minus-r count follows for all q>=3 and r>=0, including r=0. Independent exhaustive positional masks and recursive complement construction passed 36 and 25 parameter cases respectively; neither finite checker is substituted for the proof.
